_comment: Chapter 1 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F01, the first rescue: Tobi, hiding in a barrel, goes home.

text.zh_TW: 小托：「里歐！？我躲在木桶裡……他們把大家都抓走了！」
text.en: Tobi: "Leo!? I hid in a barrel... they took everyone!"

label.zh_TW: 「沿著原路跑回村裡，去找長老！」
label.en: "Run back the way I came and find the elder!"

text.zh_TW: 小托：「你……你的眼睛在發光耶。好帥！」他一溜煙跑了。
text.en: Tobi: "Your... your eyes are glowing. So cool!" He dashes off.
